slice: Widen small signed integers before DIV execution

scope.runtime: Sixteen lines in spark_div cast Int8, Int16 and Int32 operands to Int64 when both resolved operands are signed integers or NULL. The existing literal-zero path runs first. Both SQL DIV and div(a,b) share this lowering.
scope.unchanged: Decimal, string, interval and floating combinations, BIGINT overflow policy, zero handling, and other operators. No redundant cast is inserted for an existing Int64 operand.
scope.benchmark: Six typed columns and six query shapes extend the existing subquery harness to 48 ANSI-mode observations. Fixture casts run before planning/timing. Nullable and negative inputs are validated row by row; MIN / -1 belongs to the correctness corpus because the baseline cannot execute it.

corpus.origin: Local 94-query boundary/placement/mixed-type/control matrix captured against Spark 4.2.0 before implementing widening. Both ANSI modes; ordered multirow queries. Not an upstream CI list.

provenance.implementation_origin: Local adaptation of Spark integer coercion using DataFusion casts and division. Decimal coercion precedes integer division coercion in Spark, so this slice excludes Decimal peers. The inspected Sail revision still has permissive lowering; no additional Sail fix was imported.
provenance.binary_builds: Both benchmark binaries were built here with identical expanded harness source. Before-probe and before-runner are the verified parent binaries. All after binaries were built from the recorded after sources.
